market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG's true chance of winning the Champions League is around 10-15%, far below the 58.5% implied by the market. Even top teams rarely exceed 20% pre-tournament. PSG lacks consistent knockout success and faces many equally strong or stronger opponents.
evidence_points: PSG has never won the UCL, reaching the final only once (2020).
Pre-tournament betting odds typically price PSG around 8/1 to 12/1 (implied probability ~8-12%).
Other elite clubs like Real Madrid, Man City, and Bayern have deeper squads and more recent European pedigree.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of UCL winner odds
